title: Vent BOX Modular Ductless Filtration System
meta_title: Vent BOX Modular Ductless Filtration System for Chemical Safety Cabinets
meta_description: The Air Science Vent BOX is a modular ventilation and filtration unit designed to protect laboratory personnel from chemical vapors inside stand-alone safety cabinets.
meta_keywords: vent box, ductless filtration, modular filtration, chemical safety cabinet, laboratory ventilation, air purification
short_description: Air Science Vent BOX ductless filtration systems are modular ventilation and filtration units designed to protect laboratory personnel from chemical vapors found inside of stand-alone chemical safety cabinets.
full_description: The Vent BOX creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the industry, including flammable materials, acid and corrosive chemicals, paints, pesticides, and other hazardous materials. This low-profile, completely portable system requires no ductwork and can be easily positioned on shallow safety cabinets. The modular design permits multiple configurations, and the universal connections allow retrofit to almost all available flammable and safety cabinets on the market.
seo_content: Using innovative filtration technology, the Vent BOX provides a comprehensive solution for protecting laboratory personnel from exposure to a variety of chemical vapors. Its compact size and modular design make it a versatile choice for a wide range of applications where safety and compliance are paramount.

Protection & Compliance.OSHA: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood. Please consult your Safety Officer and/or Industrial Hygienist.
